bio_en: Dr Artashes Abeghian was born in Astapat in January 1878 and studied at the parish school there, the Shushi diocesan school (1887-90), the Nersisian school in Tiflis (1890-95) and the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin (1895-99). He then taught at the Shushi diocesan school and went on to an academic career and ARF public life. After the Second World War he lived in Munich, where he died in March 1955. He wrote, among other things, on the ARF and Armenian culture.
